## Selected talks

```{r}
#| output: asis
talks <- lapply(site_data("talks"), function(t) { t$where <- paste0(t$event, ", ", t$place); t })
timeline(talks, when = "year", sub = "where", body = "none")
```

## In the media {#media}

A study by ETH Zurich and Tox Info Suisse showed that accidental paracetamol poisonings increased after 1000 mg tablets became available ([Martinez-De la Torre et al. 2020, *JAMA Network Open*](https://doi.org/10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2020.22897)). I contributed the interrupted time-series analysis. The study was covered by:

```{r}
#| output: asis
media_list()
```
